Featured work

Flagship: the AI content engine

My most complete piece of work — one operation that combines all three disciplines: AI marketing strategy, generative production systems, and week-in, week-out operations management.

AI MARKETING × OPERATIONS · ONGOING

AI Influencer Content Engine

For a US health-supplement brand, I designed and operate an end-to-end AI video production pipeline: a roster of 8 fully fictional AI personas, each with a locked visual identity, voice, setting, and conversion trigger.

Every week I storyboard, generate, and deliver a full batch of short-form videos — scripts through Ingredients-to-Video generation in Google Flow, continuity-locked characters and props, and editor-ready handoff sheets for the CapCut stitch.

  • Built a 275+ script bank (177 master scripts + 100 branded) with hook-first structure
  • Authored a 13-module production knowledge base: prop library, hook rules, continuity locks
  • Ran a 40-video competitor teardown program to reverse-engineer viral hook mechanics
  • Designed comment-to-DM trigger funnels — every persona carries a unique conversion word

About
About

Idea → build → live → growing

I'm a tech generalist based in Pagadian City, Philippines, and I like taking projects the whole way: from the first conversation, through architecture and build, to a deployed product with real users — and then keeping it improving after launch.

My capstone system was presented at a research festival as a top-performing team project, then deployed for a real client — including traveling to Quezon City to run on-site user training. That project shaped how I work: present clearly, take feedback seriously, and ship things people actually use.

Today I split my time between building websites and systems for clients, and running an AI-powered content operation at production scale. If your project needs someone who can build the product and run the machine around it — that's exactly what I do.
